fact: ANCFCC's page lists digital cadastral maps covering the whole national territory among its information assets, alongside 6,750,000 land titles and cadastral plans at end 2021.
ANCFCC states its digital cadastral maps cover the entire national territory.
ANCFCC states it holds 7.7 million land titles and 260 million land and cadastral documents digitised.
ANCFCC states national territory is covered by digital cadastral maps.
ANCFCC states 86% of its 3 million users are online, including 76% of notarial deed filings and 95% of certificates issued.

The ANCFCC board communique says the project to digitalise services for citizens and institutional partners continues, with a forecast of 2,000,000 digital property certificates and an information-system overhaul in 2025.
ANCFCC director general's circular says notaries can consult documents in the agency's electronic database from 15 January 2024.
Notaries consult land documents online through a dedicated space on the ANCFCC electronic platform, for a fee.
The Agriculture Minister said ANCFCC's information system lets its central services track requests, which are handled in a fully dematerialised procedure since 4 May 2020.
Since 4 May 2020 ANCFCC users can request ownership certificates, cadastral plans and area statements online, follow the requests and pay fees remotely, per the Agriculture Minister's written answer.
LesEco.ma reports that ANCFCC's e-conservation and e-cadastre platforms are in use, letting users consult land titles and follow their files online.
LesEco.ma reports that users can now consult land titles, follow files, pay and request certificates online through ANCFCC's e-conservation and e-cadastre platforms.
BTPnews reports ANCFCC created over 373,000 land titles in 2024, with its whole cartographic archive digitised and georeferenced and cadastral requests processed automatically.
BTPnews reports ANCFCC issued over 2 million certificates through its digital channels in 2024 and set up digital counters.

Canal212 reports that ANCFCC's website lets users request property certificates, cadastral plans and copies of land-register documents online, consult published land notices, and track all formalities on a title through Mohafadati.
